expectations.name: base: messages kept
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages

expectations.name: base: artifacts kept
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artifacts

expectations.name: base: workspace memory kept
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_memory

expectations.name: base: approval audit kept
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_audit

expectations.name: base: conversation kept
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations

expectations.name: M6: workspaces read as authorized
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE authorized IS NOT 1

expectations.name: M32: deletes the vendor settings keys
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settings WHERE key IN ('aiEngine','codexPath','codexModel','codexReasoningEffort')

expectations.name: M32: keeps the other settings
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settings WHERE key IN ('fixture.theme','fixture.locale')

expectations.name: M32: drops conversations.codex_thread_id
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('conversations') WHERE name='codex_thread_id'

expectations.name: seed reached the suggestions
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions

expectations.name: M14: pending becomes new
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions WHERE title='Revisar tratamento de erro' AND status='new'

expectations.name: M14: applied becomes resolved
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions WHERE title='Aplicada no fixture' AND status='resolved'

expectations.name: M14: rejected stays rejected
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions WHERE title='Rejeitada no fixture' AND status='rejected'

expectations.name: M13: defaults on the added columns
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestions WHERE confidence IS NOT 60 OR source IS NOT 'Análise do agente' OR responsible IS NOT 'Agente de revisão'

expectations.name: M14: no pending or applied decisions remain
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestion_decisions WHERE status IN ('pending','applied')

expectations.name: seed reached the brain memories
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brain_memories

expectations.name: M15: one created entry per memory
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brain_memories m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brain_memory_history h WHERE h.memory_id = m.id AND h.action = 'created' AND h.id LIKE 'created-%')

expectations.name: M31: keeps the import row id
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_index_imports WHERE id='imp-fixture-1'

expectations.name: M31: keeps the export row id
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_index_exports WHERE id='exp-fixture-1'

expectations.name: M31: imports key is (workspace, id)
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('project_index_imports') WHERE (name='workspace' AND pk=1) OR (name='id' AND pk=2)

expectations.name: M32: openai-compatible becomes chat-completions
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_configs WHERE provider_type='chat-completions'

expectations.name: M32: no openai-compatible rows remain
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_configs WHERE provider_type='openai-compatible'

expectations.name: seed reached the changes
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM changes

expectations.name: M32: rewrites the codex origins
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM changes WHERE origin IN ('agent-command','agent-file-change')

expectations.name: M32: origin is the only origin column
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('changes') WHERE name='origin'

expectations.name: M32: neutral_origin is gone
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('changes') WHERE name='neutral_origin'
